title: The QuickBooks column shows only at a location connected to QuickBooks
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Use an organization with two locations: location A connected to QuickBooks Online, location B not connected.
custom_steps:
1. Work at location A.
  2. Open Administration > Service > Internal Work Orders.
  3. Switch to location B.
  4. Reload the page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Location A is current.

Step 2:

  • The QuickBooks expense account column shows.

Step 3:

  • Location B is current.

Step 4:

  • The QuickBooks expense account column is not shown; the other columns stay.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11758 (Story 1, Turn on Internal Work Orders, flag internal customers, manage categories)

  • S1-R13: “Administration > Service > Internal Work Orders is a page with two tabs. Internal categories: columns Category (the default carries a Default badge), QuickBooks expense account (with the QuickBooks mark; "Not set" with a warning icon when empty), Internal customers using it, Work orders (count, all time; a billable work order with a no-charge line of the category counts too), and a row menu with Edit and Archive. No Charge categories: Category, QuickBooks expense account, Original work order (Required / Not asked), Work orders, row menu. Buttons "New Internal Category" and "New No Charge Category". The starting set is seeded for every organization when this release ships, so the categories, the QuickBooks rows (S5-R5) and the hub rows (S6-R2) exist before the setting is turned on; turning the setting on seeds nothing: General Internal (default, cannot be archived); Warranty (requires the original work order), Goodwill (does not), Comeback (requires). Archived categories stay on the work orders and lines that used them and in the report filter under Archived; a "Show archived (n)" link lists them with Restore. The page needs 'Settings — Service', like every Administration > Service page; while the setting is off it shows the notice "Internal Work Orders is off. Turn it on in Settings > Work Orders." and the lists stay editable. Each list holds up to 100 active categories; past that, the New button is disabled with "You can have up to 100 active categories in this list. Archive one to add another." The QuickBooks expense account column is shown only while the current location is connected to QuickBooks.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
